### #tripwire-dead-on-arrival
A test in the suite passed for four days while measuring nothing. Its probe asked a mounted volume for a config file that was never put there, so the probe skipped on every machine — and the assertion accepted the skip as a pass. It was green the whole time. The rule that came out of it: assert a probe RAN before asserting what it printed.
